fields.text: **Updating:** only the text between the markers is ever rewritten. The version tag (`v1` $\to$ `v2`) allows automatic in-place upgrades from `views/MAP.md` to `.memory/ATLAS.md`.
**Tooling.** `repo-memory eval compare <a.json> <b.json>` in `internal/eval` does the pairing, tests and correction.

**Build-manifest sensitivity:** If a commit or working-tree diff modifies a repository build or environment manifest (`Makefile`, `CMakeLists.txt`, `platformio.ini`, `sdkconfig*`, `go.mod`, `package.json`, `Taskfile.yml`, `.github/workflows/*.yml`) anchored to a `recipe`, `tick` flags that recipe `stale_suspect: true` until its command next succeeds (`exit 0`).

**Ingestion (`repo-memory seed-docs`):** Discovers curated markdown files configured under `doc_seeds` in `.memory/config.yaml` (defaulting to `docs/developer/**/*.md` and hand-written `.agents/skills/**/SKILL.md` files that do not have `generated_by: repo-memory`). Each file is passed through the preparation layer and `repo-memory-distiller` to extract concrete `invariant`, `contract`, `gotcha...
**Best for:** Durable session-scoped memory dossiers, startup `.memory/ATLAS.md` context, and newly entered scope entries that are tracked in a per-session `InjectedSet`.

**Architectural implication for `repo-memory`:** Because the child's first `PreInvocation` fires at `initialNumSteps == 0` before its prompt is written to `transcript.jsonl`, `PreInvocation` starts the child with the baseline startup dossier (`.memory/ATLAS.md` + `global`) via `userMessage` and automatically injects task-specific scopes on subsequent `PreInvocation` calls once the child reads/t...

**Five-Tier State Scope Hierarchy & Pre-Consolidation Corroboration Gate (`VD18`, §6, §7.1):** Formalizes `temp:`, `session:`, `user:` (gitignored `<data-dir>/repos/<repo-id>/user-dossiers/`), `branch:` (`.memory/local/`), and `repo:` (`.memory/ops/` & `.memory/dossiers/`), and enforces a deterministic Pre-Consolidation Corroboration Gate requiring a passing `PostToolUse` build/test step, ver...

**Doc-Seeded Dossiers & Async Doc Freshness ("Dreaming") (`VD16`, §7.6):** `repo-memory seed-docs` (`source: doc-seed`) distills curated repository documentation (`docs/developer/`, `.agents/skills/`) into code-anchored dossier entries delivered via `PreInvocation` push, paired with an async git-diff watcher in `tick` (`source_doc_path`, `source_doc_blob_sha`) that re-distills affected entries...

**Optional Section Resolution (`{section?}`) & Five-Tier Scope Hierarchy:** Dossiers omit empty sections and separate ephemeral scratch (`temp:`), conversation state (`session:`), personal gitignored preferences (`user:`), branch-local unmerged work (`branch:` in `.memory/local/`), and git-tracked shared truth (`repo:` in `.memory/ops/` and `.memory/dossiers/`).

**Doc-Seeded Dossiers (`repo-memory seed-docs`) & Async Freshness ("Dreaming"):** Curated in-repo documentation (`docs/developer/`, `.agents/skills/`) is distilled into anchored dossier entries (`source: doc-seed`) and kept fresh asynchronously on `git diff` changes (§7.6).

**Bootstrap (`repo-memory seed-docs`):** Scans configured markdown paths (`docs/developer/**/*.md`, `.agents/skills/**/SKILL.md`, or paths listed under `doc_seeds` in `.memory/config.yaml`) and runs `repo-memory-distiller` to extract concrete `invariant`, `gotcha`, `recipe`, and `failure-signature` entries anchored to the actual source files, build manifests, and symbols they govern.
